comment: Gooey - an SSL G-bus style VCA mix-bus compressor. Linked stereo feed-forward detector (half peak, half RMS), soft knee, program-dependent AUTO release, a sidechain high-pass that only the detector hears, auto or fixed makeup, and a DJ-crossfade Mix for parallel compression. Thrsh at 0 dB bypasses it completely.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 481 LOUDER, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 492 Washout, 493 Breather, 494 Takeoff, 495 GRDELAY, 496 Sweep, 497 Looper, 501 Gooey, 502 DJFilter (this pack); probes 498-500. Check against the stock list (tools/effects_db.json) when it is available.

params.name: Thrsh
params.comment: Threshold, -40 to 0 dB in 0.1 dB steps (0 = -40 dB, 400 = 0 dB). 400 = 0 dB = OFF: the effect is bypassed (no processing, no makeup). Default OFF.

params.name: Zoom
params.comment: Meter zoom (the cover meter on 2.10 only; no effect on the sound): 0..15 = x0.5 to x8.0 rows a dB around the threshold line, which stays mid-meter. Default x1.0.

params.name: Rels
params.comment: Release: 0 0.1 s, 1 0.3, 2 0.6, 3 1.2 s, 4 AUTO (program-dependent: 0.1 s after single peaks, up to 1.2 s after sustained reduction). Default AUTO.

params.name: MkUp
params.comment: Makeup: 0 AUTO (adds back the average gain reduction), 1 OFF, 2..41 = +0.5 to +20.0 dB in 0.5 dB steps. Default OFF.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade, DJ style: dry full up to 50, wet full from 50, both full at 50 (parallel compression). Default 100.

params.name: SC HP
params.comment: Sidechain high-pass on the detector only (12 dB/oct, the audio is untouched): 0 OFF, 1..20 = 20 to 300 Hz on a log scale. Default OFF.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
dsp_cost_comment: Estimate (the spec says about 8): per sample a peak scan (plus 4 one-poles when SC HP is on) and 2 mults of gain; per block a sqrt, a log2 and an exp2. Bypassed it costs a compare. Re-measure on the pedal. Arena seal (MIDISTOMP #60, 74 words): about +210 cycles a block, +4 declared.
